newsitem.title: UK: Mid-States drops after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Mid-States drops after profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Mid-States Plc dropped 34 percent on Thursday as the company, which distributes auto products in the south-east U.S., posted a sharp fall in first-quarter profits and warned of worsening trading conditions.
The stock was down 6-1/4p at 12 by 1417 GMT in volume of 615,000 shares.
Mid-States said its pre-tax profit dropped to 322,000 stg in the first quarter from 740,000 stg a year before, on sales which fell to 17.7 million stg from 19.3 million.
Since April 1, Mid-States said it had met more difficult trading conditions, particularly in recent weeks with disappointing sales and increasing pressure on margins and costs.
"Mid-States therefore anticipates that sales and profits for the six months ended June 30 will be significantly below the corresponding period in 1996," the company said in a statement.
The company added that it was starting a programme to cut costs to match its reduced level of sales.
